rows.claim: D&D dungeon rooms are gates, not decoration: every room carries a not_clear state that refuses all forward exits until its problem (puzzle or battle) is solved, and difficulty scales with radial distance from the entrance.
rows.quote: while this is set, all exits out of the room (not the one they came from) is blocked. When whatever problem the room offers has been solved (such as a puzzle or a battle), the tag is removed
rows.steal: Port the not_clear predicate to the Mountain server: rooms.py + protocol_table.py ReceiptGate refuse valve/boil verbs on the next room's pipes while the room's problem (live fracture spray, STARVED junction, unmet Crown quota) stands; depth = graph distance from p_spring.
rows.falsifier: A refused verb perturbs the water graph (breaks tick determinism), or the gate cannot read room state from the welcome/tick snapshot without new server state.

rows.claim: DD loot is a weighted table with loss rows and trait reactions, not a bespoke reward; the estate's campaign engine already runs it and its donjon-sense pattern proves the zero-RNG pick the Mountain's no-RNG law needs.
rows.quote: one sensory atom, hashed to the room, no new geography
rows.steal: Add loot+riddles tables to the Mountain module spec keyed sha256(tick+node) like mag/game_campaign.py:495; loot mints only off real graph events (boil-on-fresh-fracture, primed siphon) into the player's hash-chained ledger row; riddles = riddler_domains-style surrogate statements of real graph constraints (the XOR junction is already one) with physics as the answer key.
rows.falsifier: The tick-keyed pick fires the same row every session on the same node (scripted feel in playtests), or a loot row would require forbidden RNG to be fair.

rows.claim: The operator's actual-play intel names PvP-as-engine (FIGHT CLUB register) and beat-over-beat stake escalation as the DD teaching, and the Mountain already carries the dormant channel for it: the Z1 GWAP verdict-feed weld.
rows.quote: Worlds Beyond Number and NADDPOD bring PvP to the table as a core

rows.falsifier: Computing agreement_score per tick needs an LLM judge in the hot loop or new frontier calls (the Drought must stay deterministic), or the verdict-feed weld cannot mint payloads per-tick server-side.
